_note: unarmedDiceByLevel: replaces the bare-handed strike with a real 5e attack (roll vs. AC, damage with this die + unarmedAbility), scaling by character level — the highest tier whose "level" is <= the current level is used. Without this trait, a punch still counts as a turn action but resolves as Minecraft's usual weak hit.
name: Martial Arts

_note: sneakAttackDiceByLevel: an extra die ADDED to the damage roll of a WEAPON attack (not bare-handed) made with real advantage — the same level scaling as unarmedDiceByLevel.
name: Sneak Attack
